manual.assortedtools.chapter.ultimate.fi: All eight fragments and a nether star make the ultimate fist. It is extremely powerful and out of the box it mines very fast and hits hard enough to kill most things in one hit.
manual.assortedtools.chapter.ultimate.fr:
Eight fragments of something an older civilization built, found in chests across Minecraft.

Laid out in order they spell out what they came from.
manual.assortedtools.description: Tool and armor sets for every material, buckets that hold more than one, throwing weapons and the wands that do the digging for you.
manual.assortedtools.title: Assorted Tools
tooltip.ultimate.fragment: A fragment of a powerful tool from an ancient civilization
